name: Kolleno
summary: Kolleno is an AR platform with AI follow-ups, cash application that matches incoming payments to invoices, and a documented set of aging reports in its help center. It is one of the few vendors here that shows plan prices: two per-user tiers with limits on invoices and turnover, then custom plans. The page does not label the currency of its dollar figures, so confirm that before comparing it with a US quote.

facts.text: Kolleno's collections page says payment reminders, follow-ups and escalations happen automatically once set trigger conditions are met. Its AP Portal Agent submits invoices through customers' AP portals.
Kolleno says its AI matches incoming payments to invoices on arrival and lets users review one-to-one, one-to-many and many-to-one matches.

The help center describes an A/R Aging Detail report, reached through Reports, Aging Analytics, that shows each open item at document level. A separate article covers customizing the buckets in the Detailed Aging Report.
Kolleno's trust center lists SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 with a 2026 certificate, SOC 1 Type II, SOC 3 and European GDPR.
Kolleno names NetSuite, QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, Xero, Sage and GoCardless among its integrations.

On the pricing page, Business Pay shows a monthly price of $650 per user and Business Plus $1245 per user. Each plan also shows a lower unlabeled figure, $545 and $995, beside a Monthly and Annual toggle. The page never states a currency code and uses the pound sign in its turnover limits.

plans.name: Business Pay
plans.notes: Currency not labeled on the page. Monthly price shown as $650, with an unlabeled $545 beside it. 1 user minimum, under 100 invoices, annual turnover under 1M in pounds, 1 ERP account, 100 SMS and 100 calls included

plans.name: Business Plus
plans.notes: Currency not labeled on the page. Monthly price shown as $1245, with an unlabeled $995 beside it. 2 users minimum, under 300 invoices, turnover 1M to 100M in pounds, 200 SMS and 200 calls included

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: 3 users minimum, over 1,000 invoices, multiple entities, 400 SMS and 400 calls included

plans.name: Enterprise Plus
plans.notes: 4 users minimum, over 1,000 invoices, unlimited payment integrations, 600 SMS and 600 calls included

hiddenCosts: The page lists SMS and call allowances as included but states no price for usage beyond them.
The page does not say which price applies to monthly billing and which to annual billing, or which currency the dollar sign means.
